# Town Meeting

Image: NA Annual Town Meeting 2026 

The Annual Town Meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 12, 2026 at 6:30 pm. It will take place at North Andover High School.  

Last day of voter registration for this meeting will be Saturday, May 2, 2026.

## Guidelines for Submitting Citizen Articles for Town Meeting Warrant

An article may be included in the Annual Town Meeting Warrant by petition of ten or more registered voters (MGL c. 39 §10). The Select Board determines the deadline for submission of warrant articles for the Annual Town Meeting. 
Petitions for submission of a citizen's article may be obtained from the Office of the Town Clerk, 120 Main Street, North Andover. The petition must have the signatures of ten registered voters in the Town of North Andover. It is recommended that the petitioner obtain additional signatures in the event that some signatures are not certifiable by the Board of Registrars.
If you have any questions, please email Town Clerk, Dawne Warren (dwarren@northandoverma.gov) or call 978-688-9501

# Town Clerk

Online Payment Center

Order Birth, Marriage, Death Certificates; Pay for Dog Licenses, Late Fees; Order Documents
Office Hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 8:30 am to 2 pm, Tuesday Evenings 5 pm to 7 pm, Wednesday 8:30 am to 12 pm

The Town Clerk is elected every three years. The Town Clerk is:

  * Chief Election Official: Oversees all elections, voter registration sessions, certifies nomination papers, initiative petitions and conducts annual town census
  * Recording Officer: Records, certifies and maintains all official actions of the town
  * Registry of Vital Statistics: Registers all birth, marriage, and death records occurring within the community
  * Public Records Officer: Administers the oath of office to all elected and appointed members. Posts all meetings of government bodies. Provides certified copies of vital records.Maintains records of all local bylaws
  * Licensing Officer: Issues licenses and permits: marriage, dog, and permits for raffles and bazaars
  * Public Information Officer: Responds to inquiries from the general public on information available through the officer

## ALL ELECTIONS ARE HELD AT 29 FOREST ST., SENIOR CENTER

Annual Town Election: Held the first Monday of May from 7 am to 8 pm at the Senior Center located at 29 Forest Street.
Annual Town Meeting: Held the second Friday of June at 7:30 pm in the Elementary School Auditorium.
